items.description: Tenant must pay Landlord a share of any Excess Rent from an assignment or sublease as Additional Rent upon receiving it.
items.span_text: Tenant shall pay to Landlord, as Additional Rent, fifty percent (50%) of any such Excess Rent immediately upon Tenant’s receipt thereof.
items.trigger: if Tenant assigns this Lease, or subleases any part of the Tenant Space, for any Excess Rent

items.description: Tenant must deliver a signed estoppel certificate statement after Landlord's written request.
items.span_text: within fifteen (15) days after written request by Landlord, Tenant shall execute, acknowledge and deliver to Landlord a statement in writing certifying all matters relating to this Lease reasonably requested by Landlord and/or any prospective purchaser of the Building and/or the Property and/or any Holder.

items.description: Tenant must sign and return additional subordination and attornment documents requested by Landlord or a Holder after receiving them.
items.span_text: Tenant covenants and agrees to execute and deliver, within fifteen (15) days of receipt thereof, and in the form reasonably required by Landlord or any Holder, any additional documents evidencing the priority or subordination of this Lease and Tenant’s agreement to attorn with respect to any such Security Document;

items.description: Tenant must mail each Noticed Holder a copy of any default notice it serves on Landlord.
items.span_text: Tenant agrees to give each Noticed Holder, by registered or certified mail, a copy of any notice of default served upon the Landlord by Tenant.

items.description: Landlord must use commercially reasonable good faith efforts to have the Holder deliver an SNDA to Tenant when the Building is subject to a Security Document.
items.span_text: Landlord shall use commercially reasonable good faith efforts to cause the Holder to deliver an SNDA to Tenant.
items.trigger: if the Building is subject to any Security Document

items.description: Tenant must surrender the Tenant Space in good working order and clean condition, ordinary wear and tear excepted, on expiration or earlier termination.
items.span_text: Tenant shall, subject to the provisions of this Article 13 and Section 8.4, quit and surrender possession of the Tenant Space to Landlord in good working order and clean condition, ordinary wear and tear excepted.
items.trigger: Upon the expiration of the Term of this Lease, or upon any earlier termination of this Lease or the termination of Tenant’s right to possess the Tenant Space

items.description: Tenant must surrender the Suite 1.5 Tenant Space in good working order and clean condition by the Suite 1.5 Expiration Date.
items.span_text: no later than the Suite 1.5 Expiration Date, Tenant shall, subject to the provisions of this Article 13 and Section 8.4, quit and surrender possession of the Suite 1.5 Tenant Space to Landlord in good working order and clean condition, ordinary wear and tear excepted.

items.description: During holdover Tenant must pay monthly Base Rent at a premium percentage of the last month's Base Rent plus the full Additional Rent.
items.span_text: During any such holdover period, Tenant shall pay to Landlord a monthly Base Rent in an amount equal to one hundred fifty percent (150%) of the Base Rent payable by Tenant to Landlord during the last month of the Term of this Lease and one hundred percent (100%) of the Additional Rent payable by Tenant to Landlord during the last month of the Term of this Lease.
items.trigger: If Tenant should remain in possession of all or any portion of the Tenant Space after the expiration of the Term of this Lease
